partner_cancellation.text: I booked a service for 4:30 PM today, and instead of informing me beforehand, they called me at exactly 4:30 PM to say that no professional was available
professional refused to come and asked me to cancel and when I told her u cancel she kept calling me till I cancelled it.
Twice professionals didn’t show up. No cancellations, no notice, just plain didn’t show up.

service_quality.text: I got burned on my hand after my waxing, and customer support said they'd give me a 400 free coupon. What do I do with my hand now?
One knocked off a good part of my eyebrow I was hoping that’s a basic skill but guess not.
Professional was in too much hurry, and didn’t do the work properly. I got rashes and skin irritation.

price_clarity.text: The first 2 days the slots were already over by 1:02 pm.
If I’m booking a spa for 970 it sums up to 1399 by the end of the payment
while booking I get to know there are platform charges, mandatory disposable kit charges which resulted me to pay extra amount unnecessarily.
